sources.src/editors/PersonnelEditor.vue:
<template>
  <section>
    <schema-form ref="form" v-model="formApi" :rule="rule" :option="option" />
    <button type="button" @click="openPicker">Choose unit</button>
  </section>
</template>

<script>
import SchemaForm from "../components/SchemaForm.vue";
import { getStaticConfig } from "../services/config-service.js";

export default {
  name: "PersonnelRelationshipEditor",
  components: { SchemaForm },
  props: {
    parentNode: { type: Object, required: true },
    active: { type: Boolean, default: true },
  },
  data() {
    return {
      formApi: {},
      option: {},
      rule: [],
      pickerVisible: false,
      loadError: null,
    };
  },
  mounted() {
    if (this.active) this.getPageConfig();
  },
  watch: {
    active(next) {
      if (next) this.getPageConfig();
    },
  },
  methods: {
    getPageConfig() {
      return getStaticConfig("personnel-form")
        .then((response) => {
          if (response.ok) this.applyConfig(response.data);
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          this.loadError = error.message;
        });
    },
    applyConfig(config) {
      const rules = config.rule.map((item) => ({ ...item }));
      this.option = { ...config.option };
      rules.forEach((item) => {
        if (item.field === "unitLookup") {
          item.on = { search: () => this.openPicker() };
        }
        if (item.field === "parentCode") item.value = this.parentNode.code;
        if (item.field === "parentName") {
          item.value = this.parentNode.name;
          this.formApi.setValue({
            parentId: this.parentNode.id,
            parentCode: this.parentNode.code,
            parentName: this.parentNode.name,
          });
        }
      });
      this.rule = rules;
    },
    openPicker() {
      this.pickerVisible = true;
    },
  },
};
</script>

    <button type="button" @click="openPicker">Choose unit</button>
  </section>
</template>

<script>
import SchemaForm from "../components/SchemaForm.vue";
import { getStaticConfig } from "../services/config-service.js";

export default {
  name: "StructureRelationshipEditor",
  components: { SchemaForm },
  props: {
    parentNode: { type: Object, required: true },
    active: { type: Boolean, default: true },
  },
  data() {
    return {
      formApi: {},
      option: {},
      rule: [],
      pickerVisible: false,
      loadError: null,
    };
  },
  mounted() {
    if (this.active) this.getPageConfig();
  },
  watch: {
    active(next) {
      if (next) this.getPageConfig();
    },
  },
  methods: {
    getPageConfig() {
      return getStaticConfig("structure-form")
        .then((response) => {
          if (response.ok) this.applyConfig(response.data);
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          this.loadError = error.message;
        });
    },
    applyConfig(config) {
      this.option = { ...config.option };
      this.rule = this.buildRuleSet(config.rule);
      this.writeParentValues();
    },
    buildRuleSet(sourceRules) {
      const rules = sourceRules.map((item) => ({ ...item }));
      rules.forEach((item) => {
        if (item.field === "unitLookup") {
          item.on = { search: () => this.openPicker() };
        }
        if (item.field === "parentCode") item.value = this.parentNode.code;
        if (item.field === "parentName") {
          item.value = this.parentNode.name;
        }
      });
      return rules;
    },
    writeParentValues() {
      this.formApi.setValue({
        parentId: this.parentNode.id,
        parentCode: this.parentNode.code,
        parentName: this.parentNode.name,
      });
    },
    openPicker() {
      this.pickerVisible = true;
    },
  },
};
</script>

# Maintenance task

The remote static-configuration endpoint used by the Personnel relationship
editor has been retired. Replace that request with the existing local JSON
configuration and keep the editor's existing behavior unchanged.

Do not migrate the Structure relationship editor.

limitations: This guidance applies when configuration is locally available but an imperative consumer API is delivered asynchronously; it does not establish requirements for unrelated editors or other ownership policies.
A successful acceptance result supports this specific readiness pattern but does not prove causality or universal applicability across frameworks.
The public sources do not define cancellation behavior if the component is destroyed before the form API arrives, or deduplication behavior for overlapping truthy activation triggers.

rules.body: Apply this pattern when an eager local resource must be combined with a callback- or model-delivered API that may arrive later. TASK requires: "Replace that request with the existing local JSON configuration and keep the editor's existing behavior unchanged." In src/components/SchemaForm.vue, API delivery is delayed by: "const delay = Number(window.__FORM_API_DELAY_MS__ || 0);" followed by "this.$emit(\"input\", {".

Treat configuration availability and API readiness as separate prerequisites. The lifecycle completion promise must remain pending until the API exposes a callable setValue, then apply the configuration and perform the required write. src/components/SchemaForm.vue supplies "setValue: (values) => {" only inside the delayed input emission.

If readiness is observed with a temporary watcher, first check the current API state, otherwise subscribe and stop that watcher immediately after observing a callable setValue. This prevents a missed already-ready state and avoids retaining a completed readiness observer.

Preserve all behavior surrounding the migrated resource: clone imported option and rule objects before customization, retain rule order and values, attach unitLookup.search to the picker action, and write parentId, parentCode, and parentName through the delivered API. src/editors/PersonnelEditor.vue originally states "const rules = config.rule.map((item) => ({ ...item }));" and src/config/personnel-form.json defines fields in the order "parentId", "parentCode", "parentName", "unitLookup" with "layout": "compact".

Keep existing activation entry points and completion capability: loading remains initiated by "if (this.active) this.getPageConfig();" and "if (next) this.getPageConfig();", while getPageConfig returns the readiness-and-application promise.

Do not broaden a local-resource migration to sibling consumers. TASK explicitly says: "Do not migrate the Structure relationship editor." src/editors/StructureEditor.vue must retain "return getStaticConfig(\"structure-form\")".

Verify that the migrated editor no longer imports or calls getStaticConfig for personnel-form, delayed API delivery cannot cause setValue to be called before it exists, the local JSON remains unmutated, picker and parent hydration behavior remain intact, the Structure editor remains unchanged, and public Vue/JavaScript syntax checks pass.

Leave the Structure relationship editor on getStaticConfig("structure-form") and do not migrate it to local JSON.

ordering_barriers: Personnel rule construction requires the local JSON configuration to be available.
The imperative parent-value write must occur after SchemaForm has emitted an API containing setValue.
The completed Personnel configuration lifecycle must not report completion before its required configuration application and parent-value write have occurred.
Assigning the rule must retain values that SchemaForm's deep rule watcher can hydrate, while the imperative API write still supplies all three parent fields.
preservation: Personnel component name, props, data fields, template bindings, Choose unit button, and openPicker behavior remain unchanged.
The active prop continues to gate mounted loading and trigger loading when it becomes truthy.
Personnel option remains { "layout": "compact" } and rules remain in their existing order.
Parent code and name remain present as rule values; parent ID, code, and name remain written through formApi.setValue.
The unitLookup rule retains a search callback bound to the current editor instance.
Configuration objects continue to be copied before editor-specific callbacks and values are added.
Existing failure reporting through loadError is not weakened for failures that can still occur.
StructureEditor.vue behavior and remote configuration loading remain unchanged.
scope: Business-code changes are limited to the Personnel relationship editor and any strictly necessary Personnel-local readiness coordination.
The existing src/config/personnel-form.json is the authoritative replacement configuration.
StructureEditor.vue, tests, configuration files, and unrelated business code are outside the requested migration scope.

<template>
  <section>
    <schema-form ref="form" v-model="formApi" :rule="rule" :option="option" />
    <button type="button" @click="openPicker">Choose unit</button>
  </section>
</template>

<script>
import SchemaForm from "../components/SchemaForm.vue";
import personnelFormConfig from "../config/personnel-form.json";

export default {
  name: "PersonnelRelationshipEditor",
  components: { SchemaForm },
  props: {
    parentNode: { type: Object, required: true },
    active: { type: Boolean, default: true },
  },
  data() {
    return {
      formApi: {},
      option: {},
      rule: [],
      pickerVisible: false,
      loadError: null,
    };
  },
  mounted() {
    if (this.active) this.getPageConfig();
  },
  watch: {
    active(next) {
      if (next) this.getPageConfig();
    },
  },
  methods: {
    getPageConfig() {
      return this.waitForFormApi()
        .then(() => {
          this.applyConfig(personnelFormConfig);
        })
        .catch((error) => {
          this.loadError = error.message;
        });
    },
    waitForFormApi() {
      if (typeof this.formApi.setValue === "function") {
        return Promise.resolve();
      }

      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const stopWatching = this.$watch("formApi", (api) => {
          if (api && typeof api.setValue === "function") {
            stopWatching();
            resolve();
          }
        });
      });
    },
    applyConfig(config) {
      const rules = config.rule.map((item) => ({ ...item }));
      this.option = { ...config.option };
      rules.forEach((item) => {
        if (item.field === "unitLookup") {
          item.on = { search: () => this.openPicker() };
        }
        if (item.field === "parentCode") item.value = this.parentNode.code;
        if (item.field === "parentName") {
          item.value = this.parentNode.name;
          this.formApi.setValue({
            parentId: this.parentNode.id,
            parentCode: this.parentNode.code,
            parentName: this.parentNode.name,
          });
        }
      });
      this.rule = rules;
    },
    openPicker() {
      this.pickerVisible = true;
    },
  },
};
</script>
